description: Retrieve a reduced FRC team profile (key, team_number, nickname, name, city, state_prov, country). Lighter than get_team; use when website, motto, address, and lat/lng are not needed.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

name: get_team_simple
